    Tree diagrams given by a table of path values #

    For an oriented tree, the value of every path from a to b is read off a table M a b : Option (obj a ⟶ obj b) that is closed under appending arrows (RayCat.OT.pval_eq_of_table). This turns the cleaving conditions of MulBasis.not_ot_diagram into conditions on vertices only (MulBasis.not_tree_table). RayCat.copyOf builds a graph copy of a quiver from a vertex map.
